name: @lynx-js/lynx-simulator
description: Lynx desktop simulator application and CLI built with Lynxtron.
author: The Lynx Authors

scripts.dev: cross-env TARGET_ENV=desktop NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k --prefix none "node scripts/rspeedy.mjs dev" "dev-ready-rspeedy && rspack dev"
scripts.dev:web: cross-env TARGET_ENV=web NODE_ENV=development concurrently -k --prefix node "node scripts/rspeedy.mjs dev" "rspack serve"
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:ui && cross-env TARGET_ENV=desktop rspack build
scripts.build:web: cross-env TARGET_ENV=web node scripts/rspeedy.mjs build && cross-env TARGET_ENV=web rspack build
scripts.start:web: npm run build:web && npx serve dist/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/main/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.open: npm run build:desktop && lynxtron dist/desktop -- open
